<p>Class quest <b>Taming the Beast</b> (:
Class quest Taming the Beast (level 10): three tames with the Taming Rod, then Training the Beast for Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet. Before taming your real Pet, put the quest one in Stable. Trainer and last tame (wowforeverguides.com, Harenil 🟡, and ForeverWisp from Wowhead):

  • Tauren: Yaw Sharpmane (Bloodhoof Village · Mulgore) → Swoop
  • Dwarf: Grif Wildheart (Kharanos · Dun Morogh) → Ice Claw Bear (first tame: Large Crag Boar)
  • Night Elf: Dazalar (Dolanaar · Teldrassil) → Strigid Screecher
  • Human ★: Josephine Carson (Elwynn Forest) → Young Forest Bear (first tame: Rockhide Boar)

Tame Beast fails on beasts above your level (Sep 24). While taming, your armor is −100%: use Aspect of the Monkey, Concussive Shot or a Freezing Trap (Warcraft Tavern). You can't tame with an active Pet, even if dismissed. Stable: 1 active Pet + 2 in Stable (Stable Master).
Come imparare le abilità del Pet (Bite,: How to learn Pet abilities (Bite, Claw, Charge, Howl, Dash, Dive)
<p>I Pet imparano <b>Bite</b>/<b>Claw</b:
Pets learn Bite/Claw, Charge, Furious Howl, Dash/Dive only from wild beasts (LePrestore from Petopia, Oct 26–27). Procedure (Zockify, LePrestore): put your Pet in Stable, tame a beast that knows the rank (Beast Lore, from 24, shows the abilities), fight with it until "You have learned a new spell" appears, then summon your Pet back and teach the ability with Beast Training. You can skip intermediate ranks. Growl, Great Stamina and Natural Armor are instead bought from the Pet Trainer.

  • Bite 3 / Claw 3: level 16 Pet. Bite 4 / Claw 4 / Charge 3 / Furious Howl 2: level 24 Pet.
  • Bite 4: Giant Moss Creeper (24–25 · Hillsbrad Foothills), Black Ravager (24–25 · Duskwood), Leech Widow (24 · Wetlands).
  • Claw 4: Elder Ashenvale Bear (25–26 · Ashenvale), Barbed Crustacean (25–26 · Blackfathom Deeps).
  • Charge 3: Bellygrub (24 · Redridge Mountains), Agam'ar (24–25 · Razorfen Kraul).
  • Furious Howl 2: Black Ravager Mastiff (25–26 · Duskwood), Ghostpaw Alpha (27–28 · Ashenvale).
  • Dive 1: Kraul Bat (30–31 · Razorfen Kraul). Dash 1: Kurzen War Tiger or Stranglethorn Tiger (32–33 · Stranglethorn Vale), so not at 30. Dash 2: Longtooth Runner (Feralas) or Ridge Stalker Patriarch (Badlands), 40–41. Dash 3: Vilebranch Raiding Wolf (The Hinterlands), 50–51 (Zockify, LePrestore).
  • Higher ranks: Bite/Claw 5 from Pet 32, 6 from 40, 7 from 48, 8 from 56 (carriers from Petopia: Plains Creeper, Scorpashi Lasher, Silt Crawler, Elder Shardtooth…). 🟡
<p><b>Marksmanship / Survival</b>: Warcr:
Marksmanship / Survival: Warcraft Tavern says the Hunter can level with any spec but Beast Mastery is the smoothest. Marksmanship does more damage but makes you pull threat away from the Pet (constant kiting); Survival is melee and traps and is played "harder". Lone Wolf (MM, +20% damage without a Pet) is not recommended for leveling. On Mobalytics the only MM guide found is Robcat (6 ♥, Oct 30).

Detail variants: (1) Pathfinding 2 + Bestial Swiftness at 20 (Crix, Zockify) instead of the 2 Endurance Training: +6% Cheetah speed and faster Pet earlier, but the 10-point prerequisite isn't met until 20. (2) Spirit Bond 2 (1% Health every 10 s at rank 1, every 5 s at rank 2, for you and the Pet) instead of one Frenzy point reduces downtime. (3) With Legacy Talented (5 points) follow Method/Crix: Ferocity 5/5, Bestial Discipline 2/2, Frenzy 1.

<ul><li>Il Pet fa la parte maggiore del:
• The Pet does most of the damage and holds threat: send it first, Growl on autocast (turn it off in dungeons if there's a tank).
  • Aspect of the Hawk always in combat; Cheetah only while traveling (if they hit you, you're Dazed for 4 s).
  • Happiness: Happy 125% damage, Content 100%, Unhappy 75%. Use Feed Pet out of combat with food from its diet (beta bug: only drops when the Pet dies).
  • The Pet takes 25% of mob XP (green or higher mobs only) and stops at your level.
  • Ranged abilities don't work within 8 yd of the enemy: keep the Pet in front.
<ul><li>Il Mana è la tua risorsa (i Pet:
• Mana is your resource (Pets use Focus). Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot and Summon Hawk cost a lot: don't spend it all, keep a reserve for Feign Death and traps (Warcraft Tavern).
  • If it runs low: let the Pet and Auto Shot work, no mana-costing abilities until it regenerates; drink between pulls.
  • Mana in combat depends on Spirit: Bestial Discipline (BM), Rapid Recuperation (MM) and Resourcefulness (Survival) help.
  • Legacy: Thrill of Adventure gives some Health and Mana for each non-trivial kill (wowforeverguides).
<p>Il Hunter eccelle nel chain pull: pas: The Hunter excels at chain pulling: you move to the next mob while the previous one dies to DoTs or traps, but watch out for live mobs wandering toward other packs (Warcraft Tavern). Feign Death (30) resets a bad pull: put the Pet on passive and call it back first, then stay down until the mobs wander off (Zockify). Before 30, use Scare Beast, Freezing Trap or Distracting Shot.

• Spirit regen stops 5 s after spending mana (including instant spells), but not with free spells (Inner Focus, racials at 0 cost).
  • Cast your spells all together at the start of the pull: long ones first (Holy Fire), then instants.
  • With Spirit Tap and Meditation the 5SR matters less but isn't irrelevant.

• Let SW:P and Devouring Plague run to the end of their duration: better to pull a second mob than to kill the first one too early (DoubleZug).

<p><b>Chi la consiglia:</b> Method (Baby:
Who recommends it: Method (Babyhoof, Oct 9: "group build"), Icy Veins (Oct 26), Mobalytics Ahlaundoh (48 ♥), Maxroll (Soda, Oct 30: two-handed build "strong in dungeons and on 2 targets but without sustain"). Sweeping Strikes is "the most important talent" for Mobalytics.

  • Icy Veins order (snippet): Slam at 20, Spearing Strike at 25, Sweeping Strikes at 30, Mortal Strike at 40, Weaponmaster 37–39 and 41–42.
  • Method order: Cruelty (Fury) first of all, then Improved Rend, Tactical Mastery, Deep Wounds, Bloodthrill, Sweeping Strikes, Weaponmaster, Mortal Strike, Unbridled Wrath.
  • Warcraft Tavern: Overpower, Sweeping Strikes, Deflection; Spearing Strike useful only against Giants/Dragonkin: skip it and max Two-Handed Weapon Specialization. Bloodthrill before Weaponmaster.
  • Weapon: axes and polearms give +5% crit with Weaponmaster; mace/staff ignore 15% armor; swords have extra attack procs.

Pro: higher single-target damage. Con: no sustain, you need First Aid and/or a healer.
<p>Fury non può dual wield prima del 20:
Fury can't dual wield before 20, and according to Maxroll it's weak until 36 (Whirlwind); Bloodthirst arrives at 40. Mobalytics (Kargoz, video 90k views, Oct 8) and Zockify (Oct 28) use it mainly as a second spec for outdoor questing after 40 (Dual Specialization at 40).

  • Mobalytics recommends Dwarf for Fury until 30 (snippet).

Ogni challenge completata vale 1 punto L: Each completed challenge is worth 1 Legacy point. There are 65 challenges (Blizzard, Method): Classes 27 (lvl 25, 45 and 60 for each of the 9 classes); Tradeskill 18 (150, 225 and 300 in Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Leatherworking, Tailoring: the non-gathering primaries, so Mining, Herbalism and Skinning give no points); PvP 12; Dungeon 3 (Novice, Experienced, Master Spelunker); Raid 3 (Hyjal, Barrow Deeps, Onyxia); Adventure 2 (Lord Valthalak questline, Explore Azeroth). Warcraft Tavern counts 62 (PvP 9, because Exalted in a battleground is worth 1 point total and not 4): difference to verify in game 🟡.
Primo punto: livello 25 del primo person: First point: lvl 25 on your first character, or 150 skill in a non-gathering primary (Warcraft Tavern, wowforever.gg, Method). Hardcorehelper also adds map exploration: not confirmed 🟡.
Account-wide: i punti sono condivisi da: Account-wide: points are shared by all non-Hardcore characters on Battle.net (Blizzard, Warcraft Tavern, Method). An alt created after the first point inherits the points 🟡 (WoW Forever Guides).
Spesa per personaggio: ogni personaggio: Spending per character: each character spends points in the three trees Professions, Adventure and Resourcefulness, independently. Cap of 16 points per character at launch (Blizzard, Method; Method says the cap will increase over time). A single character can earn up to 29 (Method): the other 13 can't be spent on that character 🟡.
Costo: ogni rank costa 1 punto. Non dich: Cost: each rank costs 1 point. Not stated explicitly: I derive it from Method's builds, for example Thrill of Adventure (5) takes 5 points 🟡. No gold cost to spend appears (Method only talks about the reset). The reset is done at the class trainer in the capital: 10 gold in beta (Method), final cost unknown.
Requisiti: i perk a 5 punti richiedono 5: Requirements: 5-point perks require 5 points in their own tree, 10-point ones require 10 points in the tree. Some require a specific perk at max: Talented requires Well Rested (5), Dedicated Study requires Bartering (2), Performance Bonus requires Bountiful Harvest (5), Frequent Flier requires Field Guide (3), Permanence requires Gourmand (3), Reagent Economy requires The Quick and the Dead (2) (wowforever.gg).
Oltre 16 punti, i punti proseguono un tr: Past 16 points, points go into a cosmetic track. Rewards are redeemed from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle 15 points, Spectral Bear Club/Cub 23 or 25 points 🟡, Spectral Bear Tabard 40, Reins of the Spectral Bear 55 (Warcraft Tavern, Method).

Porta il main a livello 25: arriva il pr: Bring the main to level 25: the first Legacy point arrives and the tab unlocks. Method then recommends bringing the main to 60 before switching to alts ('in practice').
Crea il primo alt con una classe diversa: Create the first alt with a class different from the main. Each class is worth 3 points (25, 45 and 60) only if it's new to the account 🟡. Not all race-class combinations exist (Warcraft Tavern): choose the class first.
Quando hai punti, apri il tab Legacy (ta: When you have points, open the Legacy tab (Y key, Warcraft Tavern) and spend on the alt. Suggested order: Well Rested 5 (faster Rested XP), Thrill of Adventure 5 (sustainability in the world), Talented 5 (talents from level 9, requires Well Rested at max). The remaining point goes to Field Medicine (Method).
Il livello minimo per spendere i punti n: The minimum level to spend points is not published (WoW Forever Guides) 🟡. If the tab doesn't let you spend, try again later in leveling.
Lascia l'alt in inn o capitale per accum: Leave the alt in an inn or capital to accumulate rested XP: it charges at 5% of level every 8 hours, up to 150% (30 bubbles). Rested doubles kill XP while it lasts, but doesn't apply to quests and exploration (wowforever.be XP guide). Cozy Sleeping Bag counts as a rested zone even when logged out, with up to 3 Well Rested stacks of +1% each (wowforever.be).
Fai quest del tuo livello e resta nella: Do quests at your level and stay in the right zone: quests more than 5 levels below lose 10–20% XP per level of difference (wowforever.be XP guide).
Al livello 20 con Leatherworking (skill: At level 20 with Leatherworking (skill 20), place the Camp Tent: rested up to 5% of level for an hour and it survives death (wowforever.be camping). Sit (/sit) for 1 minute near someone else's fire or camp to take the buffs.
Quando serve, manda materiali e oro dal: When needed, send materials and gold from the main by mail: between your characters it arrives instantly, with 30 copper per stack (Method). The rules on what to send are in bankAlt.
Quando l'alt arriva a 25, sblocca il sec: When the alt reaches 25, it unlocks the second class point; at 45 and 60 the others arrive (Method).
Rested XP: fai logout in inn, capitale o: Rested XP: log out in an inn, capital or Cozy Sleeping Bag. The rate is 5% of level every 8 hours, cap 150%; the total XP from 1 to 60 is 4.084.700, same as Classic (wowforever.be XP guide).
Well Rested (5 pt) è il perk con più eff: Well Rested (5 pt) is the perk with the most direct effect on speed: +4% per rank to rate and cap, up to 20% (wowforever.be, Warcraft Tavern, Method).
Talented brings talents from level 9. Method considers it useful only for leveling: at 60 it's better to re-spec.
Camp Tent (Leatherworking 20) dà rested: Camp Tent (Leatherworking 20) gives rested up to 5%. Field Guide reduces camp feature cooldowns, so you can reuse them sooner (wowforever.be camping).
Cibo: la maggior parte dei piatti dà Wel: Food: most dishes give Well Fed, i.e. +5% XP from kills for about 15 minutes (wowforever.be XP guide). Gourmand (3 pt) lengthens food buff duration by 33% (Warcraft Tavern).
Dungeon: il bonus XP dalle quest di dung: Dungeons: the XP bonus from dungeon quests was cut by 50% on Oct 1 (beta), then dungeon mobs got +20%. Don't plan leveling around dungeons 🟡: Legacy points are worth more (Spelunker, 1 point each).
Gruppi: l'XP per giocatore scende con la: Groups: XP per player drops with group size and collapses if a member is much higher level (wowforever.be XP guide). Only group with characters of your level.
Thrill of Adventure non dà XP, ma recupe: Thrill of Adventure gives no XP, but restores health and mana after kills: it reduces downtime to recover (inferred from Method).
Crea un bank alt per ogni fazione, rules: Create a bank alt for each faction, ruleset and region: mail doesn't pass between them (Method) 🟡 (single source).
Capitale: Alleanza Stormwind o Ironforge: Capital: Alliance Stormwind or Ironforge (Method prefers Ironforge, where AH and bank are in a straight line); Horde Orgrimmar or Thunder Bluff. Avoid Valanaar (Zephras Isle): it's not a rest zone and the Inn is far from the AH (Method).
Classe e razza non contano se non lo liv: Class and race don't matter if you don't level it: 'any race and any class works'. If you level it, the Mage creates portals and the Rogue opens lockboxes (Method).
Professione consigliata: Enchanting. Un: Recommended profession: Enchanting. A level 1 character can disenchant high-level items; the result is random. For prices use Auctionator, Disenchant Buddy or Disenchantry (Method). Tailoring is useful for 6-slot Linen Bags in the early stages (Warcraft Tavern).
Cosa mandare: armi e armature bind-on-eq: What to send: Bind-on-Equip weapons and armor, cloth, ores and gems, leather, herbs, meat and food ingredients. Grays to the vendor. Whites sell on AH only if the price beats vendor + 30 copper + any lost deposit (Method rule) 🟡.
Costi mail: 30 copper per stack. Il pacc: Mail costs: 30 copper per stack. The package stays 30 days in the recipient's mailbox, then returns to the sender, where it stays another 30 days before being destroyed (Method) 🟡. Account bank: not confirmed, so don't plan for it (PC Gamer, via snippet).
Solo 6 primarie non gathering danno punt: Only the 6 non-gathering primaries give points: Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Leatherworking, Tailoring. Each milestone of 150, 225 and 300 is worth 1 point (Blizzard, Method). Cooking, First Aid, Fishing and gathering give no points.
Route di Method per 16 punti con più per: Method's route to 16 points with multiple characters: level 60 (3) + two alts of different classes at 25 (2) + PvP rank 3 (1) + four professions at 225 (8, since each profession gives 150 and 225) + Novice and Experienced Spelunker (2). Method says crafting to 225 is the fastest source early on.
Enchanting alt: il materiale viene solo: Enchanting alt: materials only come from Disenchanting Green or higher gear (Warcraft Tavern). Arcane Dust is the bottleneck.
Tailoring alt: Linen Bag da livello bass: Tailoring alt: low-level Linen Bags for storage (Warcraft Tavern, Method). Tailoring + Herbalism pair for the alt in leveling order (Mobalytics, snippet only 🟡).
Cap skill: Apprentice 75; Journeyman dal: Skill caps: Apprentice 75; Journeyman from lvl 10 (cap 150); Expert from lvl 20 (cap 225); Artisan from lvl 35 (cap 300) (Warcraft Tavern). Method says the crafting cap requires 'a minimum of 3 level 20 characters': unclear 🟡.
Alt gatherer che rifornisce il main. Ore: Gatherer alt that supplies the main. Ore and hides are mailed to the main (30 copper per stack). Method calls it a 'dedicated gatherer alt' with Bountiful Harvest, Bartering, Dedicated Study, Master Chef and Luremaster. Warcraft Tavern: a gatherer supplies a crafter. Gathering gives no Legacy points.
Alt crafter: le erbe alimentano Alchemy,: Crafter alt: herbs feed Alchemy, leather feeds Leatherworking. Camp Tent (Leatherworking 20) gives rested XP to the alt. Both primaries give Legacy points (150, 225 and 300 each). Pair from Warcraft Tavern 🟡.
Main melee in plate (Warrior o Paladin):: Plate melee main (Warrior or Paladin): Blacksmithing uses Mining bars. The herbalist and alchemist alt provides potions for the main. Gfinity for class choices 🟡.
Credere che l'alt sia obbligatorio: il c: Believing the alt is mandatory: the 16-point cap can be reached even on a single character (Blizzard, Method).
Spendere i punti senza piano: il reset c: Spending points without a plan: the reset costs 10 gold in beta, and the final cost is not known (Method).
Tenere Talented a livello 60: a quel pun: Keeping Talented at level 60: at that point it's better to re-spec (Method).
Fare dungeon come piano di leveling: il: Doing dungeons as a leveling plan: the dungeon XP bonus has been changed several times in beta (wowforever.be) 🟡.
Far leveling in zone troppo sotto il pro: Leveling in zones too far below your level: you lose 10–20% XP per level of difference beyond 5 (wowforever.be).
Contare su due classi uguali: ogni class: Counting on two of the same class: each class is worth once per account 🟡, so another character of the same class gives no new points.
Mandare materiali a un bank alt di un'al: Sending materials to a bank alt of another faction, ruleset or region: mail doesn't pass (Method) 🟡.
Usare Valanaar come capitale del bank: l: Using Valanaar as the bank capital: the Inn is far from the AH and it's not a rest zone (Method).
Craftare senza sapere a chi vendere: i p: Crafting without knowing who to sell to: prices are not verified and sources advise against crafting unsellable items.
Fidarsi di siti che vendono boost o gold: Trusting sites that sell boosts or gold for Legacy points: we don't use them as sources.
Il tab Legacy si apre con Y. Un punto nu: The Legacy tab opens with Y. A new point makes the icon glow blue: to turn it off, click the challenge that gave it (Warcraft Tavern).
Il Legacy talent reset è al class traine: The Legacy talent reset is at the class trainer in the capital: plan respecs before bringing an alt to 16 points.
Method suggerisce di spendere subito Thr: Method suggests spending Thrill of Adventure and Well Rested on the first alt right away: they are the two most-used perks for leveling.
Il calcolatore Legacy di wowforever.be (: The wowforever.be Legacy calculator (16 points, shared between characters) is the reference for testing builds without spending them (wowforever.be talents).
Per le challenge di professione, porta u: For profession challenges, bring an alt to 150 in a primary the main hasn't used yet: the challenge counts once per account (🟡).
Se fai il bank alt, la classe non conta:: If you make a bank alt, the class doesn't matter: pick a capital near the AH and don't level it (Method). Mage and Rogue only matter if you level them (portals and lockboxes, Method).
